backend/main.mo: Motoko actor with a single public function `submitContactForm` that accepts name, email, and message parameters but currently performs no action (placeholder for future email/notification logic).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of Google AdSense script tag in frontend/index.html with high confidence, linking to test ID REQ-1 and multiple components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing the Sanatani-themed React application with custom styling, routing, components, and pages including Home, About, Programs, Philosophy, Contact, Donate, and Resources.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color system, including sidebar, chart, and UI component tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Google AdSense script tag (async, crossorigin=anonymous) in the head section and a root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for Home, About, Programs, Philosophy, Resources, Contact, and Donate pages, all wrapped in a Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying organization logo, quick links, contact information, social media icons, and attribution with dynamic year and caffeine.ai link with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image overlay, organization name in English and Sanskrit, Hindi mission statement, call-to-action buttons for support and learning more, and animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper component that renders Navigation header, main content outlet, and Footer for consistent structure across all pages.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four core values (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) in a grid with icons and descriptions, featuring Hindi heading and bilingual content.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation header with logo, organization name, desktop/mobile menus including links to all pages (Home, About, Programs, Philosophy, Resources, Contact, Support Us), and active route highlighting.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying program information with icon, title, and description, featuring hover effects and consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Displays a grid of four support option cards (Volunteer, Spread Awareness, Contribute Skills, Share Knowledge) with icons, descriptions, and links to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook that handles contact form submission by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method and managing submission state (loading, success, error).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing identity state and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks that will interact with backend queries; currently contains only example structure and comments.
frontend/src/index.css: Global styles with Tailwind CSS, custom CSS variables for a Sanatani-inspired warm color palette (saffron, terracotta, gold), Google Fonts imports (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), and utility classes for patterns and gradients.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page displaying the organization's story, purpose, vision, values, and community principles in a hero section, narrative text, and grid of principle cards with icons.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form for submitting messages (using useContactForm hook), contact information cards (email, phone, location), and social media links with icons.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donate page component displaying support options, impact areas with percentage breakdowns (cultural programs, education, community service, heritage preservation), and a transparency commitment section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component featuring Hero and Mission sections, a grid of four organizational highlights (cultural preservation, spiritual education, community building, social service), and a call-to-action section with support and contact links.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page explaining Sanatana Dharma principles including eternal nature (शाश्वत प्रकृति), unwavering commitment/devotion (भक्ति योग), and path of action (कर्म का मार्ग) with devotional examples from Hindu tradition.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page showcasing six organizational initiatives (Vedic study circles, cultural festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) with an impact statistics section displaying community metrics.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: Resources page providing access to four categories of materials: sacred texts, video lectures, articles/essays, and downloadable materials, each with specific subcategories for spiritual learning.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palette (including Sanatani-themed colors like saffron, terracotta, gold), typography settings with custom font families (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), and custom animations/shadows.
project_state.json: Project state file for 'Kattar Sanatani Yodha' web application tracking Google AdSense integration feature with client ID ca-pub-4905807488237044. Contains one completed feature for adding the AdSense script tag and one pending feature request for integration.
